text_block_list.text:
And so, the training camp period concluded 
without a hitch—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Good work, El. You did well this summer, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer. We're heading back to 
Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Bwah-hah-hah-hah!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
—Huh?! Pearl-senpai, what happened to your 
voice, desu ka?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's odd. Let me try one more 
time...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Bwah-hah-hah-hah!

"...It wasn't my imagination. Her voice 
was clearly hoarse. There was only one 
conceivable reason."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: DEATH SPICY SAUCE!?

"I've clearly overused my voice. It might 
be best to avoid karaoke for a while."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Pearl-senpai looks like an alien, it's 
kinda funny, YES!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I want you to say, "WE COME IN..."! 
Please, pretty please!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
An alien impression? Heheh, well if you 
insist. I'll just imitate the one that was 
captured at Patterson Base...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, people of the solar system! Surrender 
now. Admit your defeat, or I'll crash 
Planet Pearl right into Earth!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Bwah-hah-hah-hah!

...It seemed to be quite a physically 
crude alien. As the three of us chatted—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Pearl-san.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh, Dober? What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I just happened to hear a rumor. That 
you're running in the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, maybe. That, too, is part of my 
global strategy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Is that so... Then we're rivals. 'Cause 
I'm running in it too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm just a little happy. To be able to run 
again.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, indeed. But don't let your guard 
down, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Even if you are a member of my beloved 
Pearl Family, I shall show no mercy!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Bwah-hah-hah-hah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... I understand. However...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Please get your voice back to normal 
soon. It's impossible to take things 
seriously like that. Ahaha..."

A hearty laugh loses its punch when your 
voice is this raspy. Such heartwarming 
exchanges come to an end today.

"Starting tomorrow, a new season begins as 
we head toward the Rose Stakes."
